story.p1: I-{{full}} yaqala ngomzuzu wokuzingca. U-{{founder}} wabona amaqabane akhe asondeleyo eqala iinkampani zawo, kwaye wazibonela ukuba kufuna inkalipho engakanani ukuqala.
story.p2: Loo mzuzu wahlala kuye. Kudala enomdla wokunceda ii-SMME ukuba zifikelele kwiinjongo zazo, ziphuhle kwaye zikhule, kwaye wayefuna ukwakha into eza kuma ecaleni kwazo xa zisenza oko.
story.p3: Igama ngumyalezo awayefuna ukuwuthumela kumaqabane akhe asondeleyo, nakuwo onke amashishini nemibutho eyisebenzisayo: niyakwazi. Qhubekani nityhalela phambili, ningaze niyeke.

hero.body: Ukuqhuba ishishini kufuna isibindi, ukuzimisela nokusebenza nzima. Ukulilawula akufanelanga kwenze uhambo lube nzima ngakumbi. Sakha izixhobo ezilula, ezicacileyo ukuze ugxile koko kubalulekileyo: ukwakha into enentsingiselo.

mission.title: Injongo yethu
mission.body: Ukunika amashishini iteknoloji efikelelekayo, ethembekileyo nekrelekrele eyenza umsebenzi wawo ube lula, iphucule imveliso kwaye ixhase ukukhula okuhlala kuhleli.

vision.title: Umbono wethu
vision.body: Ukuba liqabane leteknoloji elithembekileyo lamashishini kuwo wonke uMzantsi Afrika nangaphaya, sincede oosomashishini baguqule amabhongo abe ngamashishini ahlala ehleli.

grow.title: Khula

manage.body: Gcina umsebenzi wakho wemihla ngemihla kunye: abathengi, iikowuti, ii-invoyisi, iimveliso, imisebenzi nemiyalezo.

succeed.title: Phumelela
succeed.body: Hlala unolwazi, wenze izigqibo ezingcono kwaye uqhubeke usiya kwiinjongo zakho. Impumelelo yahlukile kwishishini ngalinye; i-YGT ikunceda ugxile kweyakho.

builtFor.title: Yakhelwe amashishini azo zonke iisayizi
builtFor.body: Nokuba uqala ishishini lakho lokuqala, ulawula inkampani ekhulayo okanye ukhokela iqela elikhulu, i-YGT yakhelwe ukuxhasa uhambo lwakho. Izixhobo zeshishini ezinamandla kufuneka zisebenziseke kwaye zifikeleleke, zingagcinelwa imibutho emikhulu kuphela.

simplicity.title: Ubulula

accessibility.title: Ukufikeleleka
accessibility.body: Izixhobo zeshishini eziluncedo kufuneka zifikeleleke kumntu wonke.

innovation.title: Ukuyila

empowerment.title: Ukuxhobisa
empowerment.body: Sinceda oosomashishini benze izinto ngokuzithemba kwaye baqhubeke bekhula.

sa.title: UMzantsi Afrika oqaqambileyo nomeleleyo

smsSteps.account: Vula iakhawunti kwi-BulkSMS, Clickatell okanye Twilio uze uthenge ikhredithi.
smsSteps.keys: Yenza izitshixo ze-API kwideshibhodi yomboneleli uze uzincamathisele ngezantsi.
smsSteps.sender: Yongeza i-ID yomthumeli okanye inombolo evunyiweyo ngumboneleli wakho (uninzi lweenethiwekhi zoMzantsi Afrika lufuna i-ID yomthumeli ebhalisiweyo).
smsSteps.webhook: Gcina, vavanya ngenombolo yakho, uze useta i-webhook URL eboniswe ngezantsi njengedilesi ye-SMS engenayo yomboneleli.

webhookHelp.sms: Kwideshibhodi yomboneleli wakho we-SMS, seta oku njengedilesi yemiyalezo engenayo (inbound / reply webhook) ukuze iimpendulo zifike kwi-YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Ncamathisela ezi kwi-Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, uze ubhalisele "messages". Le yindlela iimpendulo zabathengi ezifika ngayo kwi-YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Qhagamshela inombolo yakho ye-WhatsApp Business ngeCloud API esemthethweni ye-Meta. Imiyalezo iphuma kwinombolo yakho kwaye iimpendulo zingena kwiMiyalezo.

whatsappSteps.app: Yiya ku-developers.facebook.com, yenza i-app yohlobo lwe-Business uze wongeze imveliso ye-WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Phantsi kwe-WhatsApp > API Setup, yongeza inombolo yefowuni yeshishini lakho uze ukhuphele i-Phone number ID ne-WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Ncamathisela ngezantsi, phawula "Sebenzisa i-WhatsApp", gcina, uze uvavanye ngenombolo yakho yeselfowuni.
whatsappSteps.token: Kwi-Business Settings > System users, yenza i-access token esisigxina enemvume ye-whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Khuphela i-webhook URL ne-verify token eziboniswa emva kokugcina kwiisetingi ze-webhook ze-Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Umthetho we-WhatsApp: ungaphendula ngokukhululekileyo kangangeeyure ezingama-24 emva kokuba umthengi ekuthumelele umyalezo; ukuqalisa incoko emva koko kufuna i-template evunyiwe yi-Meta.

savings.year: Oko kumalunga neentsuku zokusebenza ezi-{{days}} ezibuyayo qho ngonyaka.

paid.problem: “Ingaba oku kuhlawuliwe?” Ukhangela ibhanki nee-imeyile ezindala.
paid.fix: Iikowuti ezamkelweyo ziba zii-invoyisi zerhafu, izikhumbuzi zokuhlawula zithunyelwa endaweni yakho, kwaye ungabona ukuba ngubani okutyalayo.

customers.problem: Iinkcukacha zabathengi bakho zisasazeke kwi-{{tools}}, ngoko ukufumana inombolo efanelekileyo okanye imbali kuthatha ixesha.
customers.fix: Uluhlu olunye lwabathengi olunabo bonke oonxibelelwano, iikowuteshini, ii-invoyisi neencoko, iqela lakho lonke elinokukhangela kulo.

problem.memory: Imibuzo yabathengi ihlala entloko yakho, ngoko xa kuxakekile, eminye iyaphola ngaphambi kokuba kulandelwe.
problem.whatsapp: Imibuzo ingcwatywe kwiincoko ze-WhatsApp, ngoko kunzima ukubona okulindileyo okanye ukuba ngamnye uxabisa malini.
problem.excel: Imibuzo ikwisipredishithi ekufuneka umntu asihlaziye, kwaye eminye isaphuncuka.
problem.crm: Uyayilandela imibuzo, kodwa eminye isaphuncuka ngaphambi kokuba ibe yimisebenzi.

pipeline.fix: Umbhobho wentengiso obonisa wonke umbuzo ukususela kumyalezo wokuqala ukuya kumsebenzi ophumeleleyo, kunye nenyathelo elilandelayo nexabiso lawo.

tasks.problem: Ukulandela kuxhomekeke kwi-{{tools}}. Xa umntu exakekile okanye engekho, izinto ziyaphoswa.
tasks.fix: Imisebenzi enemihla yokugqibela, uluhlu lokujonga nezikhumbuzo, enikwe umntu ofanelekileyo ukuze kungabikho nto ixhomekeke kwinkumbulo.

documents.problem: Iikowuteshini nee-invoyisi zenziwa kwi-{{tools}}: zibhalwa ngesandla, zinikwa amanani ngesandla, kwaye kunzima ukuzilandela.
documents.fix: Iikowuteshini ezikumgangatho ophezulu ngemizuzu eziba zii-invoyisi ngokucofa kanye, ne-VAT, amanani nophawu lwakho zenzelwe wena.

problem.rarely: Iintlawulo ezifika emva kwexesha azixhaphakanga, kodwa akukho nto izijongileyo, ngoko enye inokuhlala iinyanga.
problem.manual: Ulandela abahlawula emva kwexesha ngokwakho, umnxeba okanye umyalezo omnye ngexesha. Kudla iiyure neencoko ezingathuthuzeliyo.
problem.remember: Abahlawula emva kwexesha balandelwa kuphela xa ukhumbula, ngoko imali oyisebenzeleyo ihlala ingahlawulwanga.
problem.automatic: Iintlawulo ziyalandelwa, kodwa kunzima ukubona ngokukhawuleza ukuba ngubani okutyala malini.

payments.fix: Bona ngokukhawuleza ukuba ngubani okutyalayo, uze uvumele izikhumbuzo ezizenzekelayo zilandele ii-invoyisi ezidlulelwe lixesha.

middle.body: Ezinye iinxalenye zeshishini lakho zihamba kakuhle, ezinye zixhomekeke kwinkumbulo nomsebenzi wezandla. Ukuzihlanganisa kwi-{{name}} kunokubuyisa ixesha lokwenene qho ngenyanga.

report.how: Olu luqikelelo, asisosithembiso, lusekelwe kwiimpendulo zakho kuphela. Ikowuteshini okanye i-invoyisi nganye ithatha imizuzu esi-8 ukuya kuma-25 ngokuxhomekeke apho yenziwa khona, xa kuthelekiswa nemizuzu emalunga ne-{{ygt}} nge-YGT. Ukulandela intlawulo efike emva kwexesha kuthatha malunga nemizuzu eli-{{chase}}. Isixhobo ngasinye esingaphezu kwezibini sidla malunga neeyure ezi-{{switching}} ngenyanga ngomntu ngamnye ekutshintsheni nasekukopeni, kwaye isixhobo ngasinye esingaphezu kwe-{{ok}} sidla amanqaku ama-2. Ixesha lokukhangela iinkcukacha zabathengi, imibuzo nemisebenzi liyakhula ngobukhulu beqela lakho.
